free_tier_limits.correction: Free unlimited API use (no call quotas or monthly fees). Free messaging subject to rate limits: ≤1 msg/sec per private chat (some sources say ~1 msg/sec), ≤20 msg/min per group, free bulk broadcast about 30 msg/sec; paid broadcast option exists for higher throughput via Telegram Stars.

notes: Verified against official Telegram Bot API docs and FAQ. Base URL, docs, auth, free tier, and getMe example match current docs. Rate-limit numbers and paid-broadcast Stars pricing need careful check against FAQ; CORS is not documented by Telegram. One or more pricing/limit claims may be imprecise.
